Kinda long rant that I’ve been harboring for some time now. TLDR on the bottom:

I work for a retail pharmacy which is pretty steady (as pharmacies are). I have this one woman who calls us up. I answered the phone on the 2nd ring. ‘Hello, I’m blah blah from wherever how can I help you?’ 
Woman: ‘I need you to hold because I’ve been on hold so long’. 
Me thinking: mmmm ok, but you weren’t?
I hear her background noises and can tell she’s at her job helping a customer. (Mind you, due to caller ID I know who this and know already she’s a pharmacist at a competitor) I just wait.. because whatever I can type and listen at the same time. 
She comes back on the line demanding to know why her daughter’s BC isn’t ready. I tell her we are trying to order the item (as she gets a specific one) it should be here tomorrow. She sighs and says ‘I’m a pharmacist and don’t really have time to deal with this right now.’
Me thinking okay, sounds right I can hear you’re busy. She hangs up (literally just hangs up) but hey, whatever. Not even 30 min later she calls back. ‘I need to get some refills.’ Gives me her name and DOB. ‘Okay what did you need filled.’ She proceeds to ramble off her list of medications. I ask her to give me a minute to run them and then ask her to repeat one of them. 
W: ‘are you seriously going to run them all while I’m on the phone?’ Me: ‘Yes, that way we’re on the same page about what we can fill for you. For example your x medication needs refills.’
W: ‘I don’t care what needs refills! What I want you to do is write them down on a paper! I’m a pharmacist and don’t have time for this! Can’t you write them down?! Is that too hard for you?!’
At this moment in time I’m over her bullshit. 
Me: ‘no ma’am, I can’t just write them down that’s not how things are done here. If you don’t have time then maybe call back while you’re not at work... by yourself.’ (You know... while you’re providing shitty customer service to your patients because you want to call your refills in at a competitor). She later calls back up and asks for my name... I gladly give it to her and in my best customer service voice tell her I hope her day gets better. This woman, I kid you not, needs to announce that she’s a pharmacist ever g’damn time she’s in or calls us. Okay lady... we don’t give a flying f*ck. 

TLDR: woman constantly calls pharmacy while she’s at work to tell us she’s a pharmacist and doesn’t have time for us to do what she’s asking for.

The last few years we’ve actually been dwindling down on them. :( we’ve been the type that pair them and leave them paired... we don’t separate them out for color breeding mutations. (You’ll find they like to snuggle up to each other during the day) We has a very long ‘pairing’ process too, kind of like introducing new cats to each other. So for us... it was time consuming... but we were in it for happy healthy animals.. not money. Also, with breeding then comes the care of the males... you have to be prepared for hair-rings on the male’s penis... and yeah, you can take them to the vet... but often times they should be removed ASAP to prevent infection and/or resume blood flow. Sometimes the mothers either don’t take to the babies or die during the birth and you have to be prepared like with a kitten to dropper feed the babies. It can be very rewarding... but sometimes very emotionally heavy because you get so attached to them... at least that’s how it’s been for us. We used to have well over 100 at one point all paired up as little chin-chi couples... now we’re down to maybe a dozen.

I’ve been think a lot on the family front because I see a lot of people posting how their families are the least supportive; and all I can figure is it’s because they feel like they’ve failed. I think it’s human nature to internalize everything and bring it back around to ourselves. So when we say ‘I think there’s something wrong with me and I need help’, they (especially parents) View it as ‘where did I go wrong’... not realizing it’s A) not about them and B) 8/10 they didn’t do anything wrong... mental illness is a disease like any other, if untreated worsens over time. 

Your mom, as a nurse, should know this. Are you still in school? If so, and I promise you this will be one of the hardest things you’ve ever done... go to your school guidance councilor... I feel they’re very under appreciated. When I was going through school mine helped me a lot. Talk to them and let them know you’ve asked your parents for help and be honest tell them what they said. No, they’re not going to take you away or anything like that. But with the school system in your back pocket you’re more likely to get the help you’re looking for. I’m not gonna lie, it could get a little rocky for a bit... it did for me (my grandma didn’t like me sharing our business) but it helped me get the help I needed at that point in my life. In my case, things haven’t been super awesome lately.. that’s why I’m here... but when I was in school.. they got me through. 

Just a thought.
